name: Ceiling-Hung / Interior Projecting
hierarchyPath: Outdoor Signs > Blade Signs > Ceiling-Hung / Interior Projecting
description: Suspended from ceiling or mounted perpendicular to interior walls. For shopping centers, food halls like Urbanspace or Gotham West Market, office building lobbies, and hotel corridors. Used for wayfinding and tenant identification in multi-story or multi-unit buildings throughout NYC and NJ.
